title: Vocabulary Harbour
description: Practise Unit 1 vocabulary in new contexts: celebrations, family history, gifts and ceremonies.

questions.prompt: The library opened in 1926. At its hundredth birthday in 2026, it celebrated its ____.
questions.explanation: A centenary marks one hundred years.

questions.prompt: A town has used the same bridge for one hundred years. The event marking this anniversary is its ____.
questions.explanation: A centenary marks one hundred years.

questions.prompt: Which word means a celebration of the hundredth anniversary of an event?
questions.explanation: A centenary marks one hundred years.

questions.prompt: The pupils found a ____ solution that nobody else had thought of.
questions.explanation: Brilliant can mean excellent or very clever.

questions.prompt: The judges called the young inventor's clever design ____.
questions.explanation: Brilliant can mean excellent or very clever.

questions.prompt: Which word best describes an exceptionally clever idea?
questions.explanation: Brilliant can mean excellent or very clever.

questions.prompt: My aunt, my cousin and my uncle are all my ____.
questions.explanation: Relatives are members of your family; living cousins and aunts are not your ancestors.

questions.prompt: We invited our cousins and aunts, who are our living ____, to lunch.
questions.explanation: Relatives are members of your family; living cousins and aunts are not your ancestors.

questions.prompt: Which word includes your brothers, cousins and grandparents?
questions.explanation: Relatives are members of your family; living cousins and aunts are not your ancestors.

questions.prompt: My great-great-grandparents were among the ____ who lived here long before I was born.
questions.explanation: Ancestors are family members from earlier generations from whom you are descended.

questions.prompt: The family tree shows the ____ from whom our family is descended.
questions.explanation: Ancestors are family members from earlier generations from whom you are descended.

questions.prompt: Which word describes your great-grandparents and the generations before them?
questions.explanation: Ancestors are family members from earlier generations from whom you are descended.

questions.prompt: The artist covered the metal badge with blue ____ to give it a hard, shiny finish.
questions.explanation: Enamel is a hard, often coloured coating used to decorate objects such as jewellery.

questions.prompt: The jeweller used coloured ____ to decorate the surface of a silver bracelet.
questions.explanation: Enamel is a hard, often coloured coating used to decorate objects such as jewellery.

questions.prompt: Which material can form a hard, colourful coating on a metal ornament?
questions.explanation: Enamel is a hard, often coloured coating used to decorate objects such as jewellery.

questions.prompt: When the lights went out, Huda used a battery-powered ____ to find the stairs.
questions.explanation: A torch is a portable light that helps you see in the dark.

questions.prompt: Before entering the dark cave, the explorer switched on her ____.
questions.explanation: A torch is a portable light that helps you see in the dark.

questions.prompt: Which item would help you see a path at night?
questions.explanation: A torch is a portable light that helps you see in the dark.

questions.prompt: The island became free from another country's rule and celebrated its ____.
questions.explanation: A country gains independence when it is no longer ruled by another country.

questions.prompt: The national museum explains how the country won its ____.
questions.explanation: A country gains independence when it is no longer ruled by another country.

questions.prompt: Which word means freedom from another country's rule?
questions.explanation: A country gains independence when it is no longer ruled by another country.

questions.prompt: A male chicken called a ____ stood beside the hens.
questions.explanation: A cockerel is a male chicken.

questions.prompt: On the farm, the ____ crowed while the hens searched for food.
questions.explanation: A cockerel is a male chicken.

questions.prompt: Which word names a male chicken?
questions.explanation: A cockerel is a male chicken.

questions.prompt: The invitation asked guests to wear ____ clothes, such as suits, rather than sportswear.
questions.explanation: Formal clothes are suitable for serious or official occasions.

questions.prompt: For the official award ceremony, our teacher chose a ____ jacket and tie.
questions.explanation: Formal clothes are suitable for serious or official occasions.

questions.prompt: Which word describes clothing suitable for an official ceremony?
questions.explanation: Formal clothes are suitable for serious or official occasions.

questions.prompt: The whole team met to ____ winning the final match.
questions.explanation: To celebrate is to do something enjoyable to mark a special event or achievement.

questions.prompt: We will ____ our grandparents' anniversary with a special meal.
questions.explanation: To celebrate is to do something enjoyable to mark a special event or achievement.

questions.prompt: Which verb means to mark a happy event with special activities?
questions.explanation: To celebrate is to do something enjoyable to mark a special event or achievement.
